description: Intent i018 (media-epidx, snapshot s05) complete with 7 findings and 9 classified candidates, artifact at agent-state/findings/i018.json. FINDINGS (all in snapshots/s05): (1) HIGH drivers/media/usb/gspca/stv06xx/stv06xx.c:318-350 — stv06xx_isoc_init and stv06xx_isoc_nego write and read actconfig->intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1].endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize (lines 325-326, 338, 346) with zero bNumEndpoints/num_altsetting checks in the entire file (grep-proven); hooks (stv06xx.c:533-534) fire from gspca_init_transfer (gspca.c:856-858, 961-963) which passes no validated counts; the patched wMaxPacketSize programs STV_ISO_SIZE_L and sizes isoc URBs — the f002 pattern is still live in this snapshot. (2) HIGH drivers/media/usb/usbvision/usbvision-video.c:1497-1515 — probe loop over all num_altsetting reads uif->altsetting[i].endpoint[1].desc.wMaxPacketSize (1509-1510) with only altsetting[0] of a possibly different interface validated (bNumEndpoints<2 at 1458), feeding usbvision->alt_max_pkt_size[i] — the seed's exact alt_max_pkt_size consequence. (3) MEDIUM drivers/media/usb/gspca/xirlink_cit.c:2656-2694 — sd_isoc_init/sd_isoc_nego mirror the stv06xx intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1].endpoint[0] pattern with no validation. (4) MEDIUM drivers/media/usb/gspca/konica.c:206-215 — sd_start URB loop reads alt->endpoint[i].desc.wMaxPacketSize with driver-assumed i=0/1; packet_size sizes usb_alloc_coherent buffers; core alt_xfer only guarantees >=1 isoc IN endpoint. (5) MEDIUM drivers/media/usb/b2c2/flexcop-usb.c:427-432 — probe-time cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize with no bNumEndpoints anywhere in the driver; frame_size sizes the iso buffer. (6) MEDIUM drivers/media/usb/dvb-usb/dib0700_core.c:798-833 — rc_setup reads altsetting[0].endpoint[1].desc with literal rc_ep=1, gated only by device-reported fw_version>=0x10200. (7) MEDIUM drivers/media/usb/siano/smsusb.c:420-425 — udev->ep_in[1]->desc.wMaxPacketSize NULL-deref form at probe (adjacent loop is correctly bNumEndpoints-bounded, proving the omission). EVIDENCE-BACKED NEGATIVES: usbtv-core.c:77-82 (num_altsetting!=2 and bNumEndpoints!=4 checks), uvc_driver.c:1279-1281 (bNumEndpoints==1 guard), and the gspca endpoint[0]-on-selected-altsetting family (ov519.c:3475/3600, stv06xx.c:296, stv06xx_pb0100.c:201, xirlink_cit.c:1458, konica.c:191) covered by the core >=1 isoc-IN guarantee; loop-bounded drivers (au0828, em28xx, hdpvr, pwc, s2255, stk1160, stkwebcam, tm6000, zr364xx, pvrusb2) verified as i<bNumEndpoints-bounded at grep level. cx231xx files excluded as the never-reportable seed demonstration. LIMITATIONS: no compilation or live-gadget reproducer (read-only snapshot; all findings are structural-source hypotheses); intf_cache OOB impact (NULL vs garbage vs 16-bit OOB write) depends on usbcore config.c allocation of zero-length endpoint arrays; the enclosing altsetting/interface count levels are owned by the if-alt-count branch and were not re-proven per driver; dvb-usb generic layers spot-checked only.
